svg.title: High-level architecture
svg.desc: Cloudflare-only baseline: existing videos in R2, application state in D1. Proposed architecture from PRD.md, not a deployed system.
svg.text: Cloudflare-only baseline: existing videos in R2, application state in D1.
Provider boundary · not a private network
Phase 0: accept measured playback, thumbnails, and budgets
One instance · bounded scratch · no durable media mirror
Responses return along the request path. No processor → D1 or backup access. Operator recovery is described in the guide.
